library_purpose: Private, rebuildable local research records for source identity and material references, observed work units, method atoms, applicability and actual downstream use.

canonical_records.source: sources/SRC-<16 uppercase hexadecimal digits>.json (includes source_material reference, version and read scope; authorized captured excerpts live here once)

derived_cache.read_behavior: info and query are read-only; they do not build, repair or rebuild caches
derived_cache.managed_updates: put and explicit rebuild-index maintain the global catalog and compatible category indexes

categories: Choose each atom category under SKILL.md > 归类与原子复用: honor explicit user assignment; otherwise inspect and reuse existing categories by primary reuse purpose or work type. The five analysis adapters are method routes, not storage classes; reuse one atom across consumers through authorized bindings. Create a concise stable lowercase slug only if no existing category fits, when the first authorized atom is saved. Clarify only when plausible choices materially change long-term retrieval or existing organization; do not provision empty category directories.
privacy: Keep source, atom and usage records local by default. Share only after reviewing each record and destination.
